therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced Parkinson's Disease who previously completed a double-blind pramipexole study (NCT00466167)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of patients with adverse events, adverse drug reactions, and serious adverse events over 80 weeks

results.effect_size: AEs: 83.7% (PPX ER prior), 79.9% (PPX IR prior), 85.3% (placebo prior); ADRs: 48.8%, 45.3%, 52.7%; SAEs: 8.9%, 10.1%, 10.9%
biomarker_changes: UPDRS II+III change from OL baseline: -3.6 (previous placebo), +1.1 (previous PPX ER), +2.5 (previous PPX IR)
UPDRS III change from OL baseline: -3.1 (previous placebo), +0.7 (previous PPX ER), +1.3 (previous PPX IR)
Epworth Sleepiness Scale change from OL baseline: +0.5 (previous placebo), +1.2 (previous PPX ER), +1.2 (previous PPX IR)
Parkinson Fatigue Scale change from OL baseline: -0.3 (previous placebo), +3.8 (previous PPX ER), +3.5 (previous PPX IR)
subgroup_findings: Previous placebo patients showed greater UPDRS II+III improvement (-3.6) vs previous PPX ER (+1.1) and PPX IR (+2.5) at week 80
CGI-I responders at 32 weeks: 50 (previous placebo), 106 (previous PPX ER), 114 (previous PPX IR)
PGI-I responders at 32 weeks: 45 (previous placebo), 102 (previous PPX ER), 113 (previous PPX IR)
No cases of pathological gambling observed; low rates of compulsive buying and compulsive sexual behavior
safety_signals: Overall AE rates were similar across prior treatment groups (79.9–85.3%)
ADR rates ranged from 45.3–52.7% across prior treatment groups
SAE rates ranged from 8.9–10.9% across prior treatment groups
Epworth Sleepiness Scale scores increased slightly over 80 weeks
Low incidence of impulse control disorders (compulsive buying: 4 patients; compulsive sexual behavior: 4 patients; pathological gambling: 0 patients)
Cardiovascular SAEs reported including acute MI, cardiac arrest, cardiac failure, aortic valve stenosis

dose_info.dose_modifications: Dose adjustments allowed; at week 80: 115 patients reduced, 136 unchanged, 115 increased pramipexole dose

context.comparator: No comparator (open-label extension; prior treatment groups: previous placebo, previous PPX ER, previous PPX IR)
context.investigator_commentary: This study was designed to obtain long-term safety and tolerability data on pramipexole ER in patients who previously completed a double-blind pramipexole study in advanced Parkinson's Disease (NCT00466167).

results_by_chain.endpoint: Percentage of patients with adverse events (80 weeks)
results_by_chain.population_description: Advanced Parkinson's Disease patients who previously completed a double-blind pramipexole study

results_by_chain.endpoint: UPDRS II+III change from OL baseline at week 80
results_by_chain.population_description: Advanced Parkinson's Disease patients previously treated with PPX ER

results_by_chain.endpoint: UPDRS III change from OL baseline at week 80
results_by_chain.population_description: Advanced Parkinson's Disease patients previously treated with placebo
